author: kund25482
quote:
So yes, I played the game. I haven't finished it yet—I am still playing—and I will be honest here.
The details and the world are phenomenal, but it doesn't feel like a GTA game to me so far. It's very restrictive. Yes, there are some good moments here and there, but Rockstar has alienated their own fanbase with this. People waited 13 years for this game and it came out buggy.
It seems Rockstar is on their way to losing player trust as far as I see it. After years of high-polish games with memorable characters, Lucia and Jason just aren't that memorable so far. I'm still playing, so maybe my score could go higher, but sadly I doubt it. Such a shame. I knew it might be a bit slow because of the "couple dynamics," but this boring? I'll finish the game, delete it, and move on. Honestly, if this game wasn't labeled as "GTA" and wasn't made by Rockstar, it wouldn't sell.

author: kund25482
quote:
Honestly, my experience with the game was pretty boring. While the graphics look great and the initial combat is cool, the gameplay quickly becomes repetitive. Too much of the game relies on linear, "hand-holding" cinematic sequences where you aren't doing much besides walking forward or watching a cutscene. I expected a lot more freedom and engaging action from a Wolverine game, but it ended up feeling like a tedious chore to get through.
And honestly thats not Wolverine its Soyvalrine to me.
Sweet Baby Inc keeps on ruining games.
The Story was mid.
Gameplay was meh.
I personally don't recommend it wait until its on PS Plus don't spend 70$ on this.
